articles.title: Bowen: Iran deal ends Trump's war that revealed limit of US dominance
articles.description: The deal to end fighting and re-open the Strait of Hormuz leaves the sides where they were 24 hours before the war - only with thousands now dead.

articles.title: Russian strikes kill 11 and set historic cathedral in Kyiv ablaze
articles.description: A Ukrainian drone attack in the Russian city of Tula, south of Moscow, killed three people.

articles.title: Trump's Iran war is one of the greatest strategic blunders in US history
articles.description: The Iran "deal" is a tacit admission of strategic defeat by the Trump administration and of a failure to achieve nearly all of his war aims.

articles.title: Drone strikes in Sudan killed over 1,000 people in five months, says UN
articles.description: More than 1,000 people were killed in drone strikes in Sudan in the first five months of this year, the United Nations has revealed.
